skill.name: fal-workflow
skill.description: Generate workflow JSON files that describe chained AI model steps.
skill.summary: Draft structured workflow JSON for chained AI model pipelines.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code, scripts, environment access, or command execution. The two hardcoded URL findings are source documentation links, not network behavior. No evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 4 is front-matter source metadata that points to the upstream repository. It is not an instruction to make a network request or transmit user data.
Line 22 is a reference link to the source repository for more information. The skill does not direct the agent to fetch the URL or send data externally.

content.value_statement: Designing chained AI workflows can be slow when each model step must be described consistently. This skill helps draft workflow JSON structures for model chaining.
actual_capabilities: Draft workflow JSON files for chained AI model steps.
Help describe model inputs, outputs, and step order.
Support planning for multi-model AI workflow structures.
Provide a repeatable prompt context for workflow generation.
Point users to the upstream fal workflow skill reference.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not execute workflows.
It does not validate workflow JSON against a live fal API.
It does not include model pricing, availability, or runtime checks.
It cannot guarantee that generated workflows will run without adjustment.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Model Chain
use_cases.description: Create a first workflow draft that connects several AI model steps in a clear order.

use_cases.title: Document Pipeline Intent
use_cases.description: Describe how prompts, generated assets, and model outputs should move through a workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare Implementation Handoff
use_cases.description: Convert a planned AI process into structured workflow notes for engineering review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple model chain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-workflow skill to draft a workflow JSON plan for this task: [describe task]. Include each model step and its purpose.

prompt_templates.title: Add Inputs and Outputs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with known data flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-workflow skill to design a chained AI workflow. Inputs are [inputs]. Expected outputs are [outputs]. Show how each step passes data forward.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a workflow draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-workflow skill to review this workflow plan: [paste plan]. Improve the step order, naming, and input-output mapping.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-workflow skill to create an implementation-ready workflow JSON design for [use case]. Include assumptions, failure points, and validation notes.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for turning a text prompt into an image and then improving image quality.
output_examples.output: A workflow outline with a prompt intake step, an image generation step, an enhancement step, and a final delivery step.

output_examples.input: Review my multi-model workflow draft for unclear data flow.
output_examples.output: A revised plan that names each step, clarifies what each step receives, and explains what each step returns.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff for a content pipeline that uses several AI models.
output_examples.output: A structured workflow description with model roles, expected inputs, expected outputs, and notes for implementation review.

best_practices: Name each workflow step by its role and expected result.
Define inputs and outputs before asking for workflow JSON.
Review generated workflow structures against the target runtime documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not assume generated workflow JSON is production-ready.
Do not omit data flow details between model steps.
Do not include secrets, private keys, or customer data in prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps draft workflow JSON structures for chaining AI model steps.

faq.question: Does the skill run fal workflows?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for creating workflow files and does not execute them.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it validate the generated JSON?
faq.answer: No. You should validate generated workflow files with the target platform tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the workflow goal, model steps, inputs, outputs, and any constraints.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to use with secrets?
faq.answer: Do not include secrets or private data in prompts. The skill does not need them.
